module: World Editor Inspector window: displays and edits the fields (static, dynamic, arrays) of the selected object or objects, with specialized editors (vehicle metallic paint, GroundCover billboard UVs, light color/intensity/cookie, DecalData labels) and undo/redo via editor.history. Several instances can coexist, including instances locked to a selection. A modder uses it to register handlers per selection type or field modifiers.
usage:
editor.registerInspectorTypeHandler("my_type", function(inspectorInfo) ui_imgui.Text("My panel") end)
-- then: editor.selection = {}; editor.selection.my_type = {1}
notes: The default selection type is "object" (handler objectInspectorGui).
onEditorGui emits the hook onEditorInspectorHeaderGui(inspectorInfo) at the top of the window (used e.g. by editor_lightClassConverter).
Instance indices are strings (JSON keys), not numbers.
The class's editor.* functions are installed by onEditorRegisterApi / onExtensionLoaded (registerApi).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called at load: initializes the collapsible groups and installs the editor.* API (addInspectorInstance, registerInspectorTypeHandler...).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Initializes the valueInspector, registers the "object" handler, the Window > Inspector menu entry and the custom field editors/labels (BeamNGVehicle.metallicPaintData, GroundCover.billboardUVs, DecalData.texRows/texCols, PointLight/SpotLight color, intensity, cookie).

onEditorActivated.desc: Called when the editor is activated: resets the valueInspector tables and the shared context, then refreshes the selection.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Called when the editor is deactivated. Empty body.

onEditorGui.desc: Draws each inspector window every frame (closes the instances whose window is no longer visible) and handles the pending night lighting refresh.

onEditorLoadGuiInstancerState.desc: Restores the inspector instances from the editor's saved state.

onEditorSaveGuiInstancerState.desc: Writes the inspector instances into the editor state (key "inspectorInstances").

onEditorObjectSelectionChanged.desc: Called when the selection changes: ends a possible "pickingLinkTo" or rebuilds the list of fields common to the selected objects (with usage counter).

onEditorAfterOpenLevel.desc: Called after a level is opened: reloads the datablock lists of the dropdown menus.

editor.desc: Methods added to the global `editor` table by this module.

checkEditorDirtyFlag.desc: For each selected object, calls inspectUpdate(); if the object is modified (or isEditorDirty), marks the editor as modified (editor.setDirty). Does nothing if already dirty.

addInspectorInstance.desc: Creates a new inspector window. With a selection, the instance is locked to it (own context); without, it follows the current selection.

closeInspectorInstance.desc: Closes an inspector instance and unregisters its window.

getInspectorTypeHandlers.desc: Returns the handlers registered per selection type.

registerInspectorTypeHandler.desc: Registers the inspector rendering of a selection type (key of editor.selection).

guiCallback.desc: ImGui drawing function called with the inspector instance (inferred from the calling code of levelSettings).

registerInspectorFieldModifier.desc: Registers a field modification callback, identified by a unique name.

inspectorHasField.desc: Indicates whether the shared inspector currently displays a field of this name.

returns.desc: true if the field is present.
